authorReviewNote: Racing kayak double-bladed paddle, not single blade/fixed oar/punting pole. ICF2025 sprint law10.1.1 actual indexed passage inspected, direct fetch failed honestly. Racing scope avoids recreation adaptations. Two-oar sculling is different equipment, no answer overlap.

Racing canoe single blade, alternativesdouble/fixedoar/handpaddleswrong. ICF2025sprint10.1.2 explicit. Not semantic duplicate of existing Hobbies question about canoe paddle's propulsion purpose: blade type is a new fact. No unsupported kneeling/equipment material claim.

Slalom hanging gates, not hoops/divingboards/movinggoals. ICF slalom actual gate-requirements8.3.1 identifies two suspended poles, other requirement names hanging system. Tracked document current text identified; no deleted numerical rule used. Not canoe sprint lane buoys.

Safety helmet protects head, not speedmeter/buoyancy-source/steering. ICF freestyle actual safety helmet fitted to head and EN1385 requirement checked. General intended equipment purpose, not instructions or guarantee of full protection. Main buoyancy comes from different aid.

Buoyancy aid helps stay afloat, not head impact protection/depth measurement/boat waterproofing. Actual ICF slalom3.5 definition explicitly trunk-worn buoyancy device. Help wording does not promise rescue/survival or underwater breathing. Revised absurd current-stopping distractors.

Traditional orienteering navigation map/compass, not only timing/whistle or astronomy/measuring pairs. IOF actual1.1 definition checked. Traditionally qualifier permits recreational navigation adaptations; no specific contemporary device-ban question.

Standard prescribed-order course finds control points. Refreshment stalls/homes/tallesttrees wrong. IOF actual1.1 and20.6 omission/wrong-order rules inspected. Standard course qualifier avoids free-order score-orienteering variation. Self-contained meaning and grammar sound.

Punch registers visit, not map-scale change/everyone's timer/control relocation. IOF actual19.1 proof-of-passage and20.3 punching checked. Both physical and electronic registration allowed by prompt; doesn't imply every recreational course needs electronic equipment.

Orange/white standard control flag, other paired colours incorrect. IOF actual19.2 diagonally divided panels explicit. Replaced contour-line question duplicated in General Knowledge. Does not confuse physical triangular flag with map's circular control symbol.

Map control circle, notsquare/star/diamond. IOF O-Map Wiki actual ISOM703 control-point definition explicitly centre of circle; indexed passage inspected. Replaced map-key question duplicated in General Knowledge. Source is federation standards wiki, not unverified fan interpretation.

Most targets basket/chains, not turf-hole/crossbar-goal/backboardhoop. PDGA actual completing-hole Q&A explicitly tray/chains and basket. Most permits legal object-target courses, no claim touching chain alone always completes hole.

Fewer total throws including penalties better ordinary stroke play. PDGA actual object-of-game fewestthrows and penalties definition inspected. Other totals/time/discs count not score. Added penalty precision; excludes match-play/other alternative scoring formats.

Hole starts teeing area, not putting zone/fairway/arbitrarydropzone. PDGA actual800 explicit begins tee/ends target. Replaced car-park silliness with real course areas. Normalhole start, not unusual provisional/re-throw location question.

Changed general putting-purpose question to explicit PDGA806.01 classification: every throw within10m target is a putt. Other classifications rethrow/penalty/abandonedthrow not automatic from distance. Actual rule paragraph inspected. Avoids tactical layup also being possible purpose of a close throw. Metres British spelling consistent.

Normal next-tee order lowest preceding-hole score. PDGA2026 actual802.02B inspected, ties preserve previous order and consent can vary flow. Normally accounts for those exceptions. Replaced trivial disc-golf-uses-disc stem; other scores bag-size/longestthrow/lastfinisher not rule.

Ultimate flying disc, not rugbyball/shuttle/puck. WFDF current2025-2028 actual introduction inspected. General sport name doesn't itself state equipment. No claim every recreational flying-disc game is ultimate.

Catch pass in attacking endzone scores, not crossbar kick/basket bounce/carrywholefield. WFDF actual objective explicit. Normally qualifier handles stoppages and possession requirements; not asserting a running carry is legal.

Established pivot may pivot/pass, not run helddisc/dribble/courtesyhandoffopponent. WFDF actual thrower may not run and may pass to teammate; established-pivot wording avoids catch momentum exceptions. Clear normal possession options.

Legally incomplete pass normally turnover, not score/endmatch/unlimitedredo. WFDF actual introduction explicit incomplete-pass possession changes. Normally allows foul/retracted-call/stoppage exceptions; no all-errors-always-turnover exaggeration.

Spirit fairplay/player responsibility, not win-at-any-cost/no discussion/spectatorsdecide. WFDF actual self-officiation/Spirit introduction inspected. Does not insist every league has no observers/referees; underlying fairplay principle remains.

Field hockey stick strikes ball, notracket/roundfaceclub/boatpaddle. FIH current2027 definitions and stick requirements checked. Standard outdoor scope avoids ice hockey puck confusion. Broad tool fact not historical team trivia.

Flat/front side, not rounded back/equalboth/tophandleonly. Current FIH stick drawing/9.5 prohibits back-of-stick play; ordinary front-face wording includes permitted edges without claiming only a precise planar patch may touch. Other offered sides not valid alternatives.

Normal goal requires attacker play ball inside circle before crossinggoalline. Current FIH8.1 exact in-circle scoring condition checked; elsewhere onpitch/backlinecorner/outofpitchwrong. Normal excludes penalty-stroke/exceptional own-goal interpretations. Does not say goal always follows any in-circle touch.

Replaced D slang question because exact abbreviation was absent from current FIH PDF, and search hit D only as a diagram dimension label. Current FIH6.3c explicitly aftergoal centrepass by concedingteam, not penaltycorner/penaltystroke/bully. Normally permits interrupted/forfeited matches. Clear useful gameplay fact.

Full outdoor team maximum11, not7/9/15. Current FIH2.1 actual elevenplayersatanytime limit inspected. Replaced vacuous goalkeeper-prevents-goals question. Maximum avoids temporary suspensions/removedgoalkeeper/minimumplayers ambiguity; no comparison with indoor or Hockey5s.
